other_conditions: Must be a pregnant woman aged at least 19 years
Must be employed and experiencing wage‑loss due to pregnancy
Scheme applicable only for the first live birth
Benefit must be claimed within 270 days of the child’s birth
In case of miscarriage or still‑birth, the beneficiary is treated as a fresh case for any future pregnancy
For a second pregnancy, incentive is provided only for a girl child; twins/triplets with at least one girl qualify for the incentive for the second girl child

Eligibility includes women holding a BPL ration card, beneficiaries under Pradhan Mantri Jan Aarogya Yojana (Ayushman Bharat), e‑Shram card holders, Kisan Samman Nidhi beneficiaries, MGNREGA job‑card holders, women with net family income less than ₹8 lakh per annum, pregnant and lactating AWW/AWH/ASHA workers, and women holding a ration card under the NFSA Act 2013, as well as any other category prescribed by the Central Government
benefits_summary: Cash incentive of ₹5,000 for the first child (in two installments) and ₹6,000 for a second girl child (in one installment)
